1.0.1.en: Added the network map: every device drawn as a star joined to the ones it relays through, the route each takes back to Homey, and a quality grade on every hop with the weakest links listed first.

1.1.0.en: Added fullscreen for the network map. On a phone held upright the map turns sideways, so turning the phone gives a wide view, and tapping a device shows its route to Homey in a panel beside the map.

1.1.1.en: Added webserver so the visualizer can be viewed in a browser.

1.2.0.en: Added a snapshot history. The app can save your Zigbee network on the clock, every 1, 2, 4 or 8 hours, keeping up to 24, and in the browser view you can step back through them; switch it on with the gear in the history bar, it is off by default. You can also see what changed between snapshots: devices that switched parent, joined or left are marked on the map and listed in a new Changes tab, the history bar marks the snapshots where routes changed, and every device shows its route history, with a warning when it keeps switching parents.
